comment: KYRO guided demo v2 — longer than a sizzle, paced like one. Voice: upbeat professional female (ElevenLabs Bella). KYRO is ALWAYS written 'Cairo' in vo text so TTS pronounces it like the city. Accounts: torrey.munroe profile (minted token) — org home, NMB (enrollment/statements/budget/accreditation), South Plantation (cash forecast + cash & collections), Sample High (analytics).

scenes.shows: Landing hero video only (the website showcase) — everything after this is in-app
scenes.vo: Meet Cairo — the operating platform for independent schools. A hundred moving parts, one place.

scenes.shows: Org home → click Open Daily Briefing → the briefing reads the network's main concerns
scenes.vo: Sign in as a superintendent, and every morning starts with the Daily Briefing. One click — and Cairo has already read all three schools, and walks you through what actually matters: the decisions waiting, the items going critical, prioritized across the network. You can even press play, and hear it read aloud.

scenes.shows: ANCHOR org detail: briefing hero, org KPIs, Schools tab, Needs attention tab, then CLICK North Miami Beach tile → inside the school
scenes.vo: This home screen is the whole network. Organization K P Is roll up margin, days of cash and enrollment across every school. The Schools tab compares each campus side by side. Needs attention surfaces exactly what's slipping — and where. And when something deserves a closer look — click the school, and you're inside it.

scenes.shows: NMB /enrollment — the 436-student gauge, grade chips, waitlist/new/flags/withdrawn
scenes.vo: This is North Miami Beach. Enrollment intelligence opens with the live picture — four hundred thirty six students, grade by grade, with waitlist, new admits, support flags and withdrawals at a glance.

scenes.shows: Scroll to Roster analytics; work the filters (grade select, IEP chip); mention CSV + SIS
scenes.vo: Underneath sits the full roster. Filter by grade, status, race, gender or age band — or flags like I S P, five oh four, and E L L. Load it once from the C S V your S I S already exports — or connect the S I S directly, and the roster keeps itself current.

scenes.shows: NMB /statements — Activities with PY + Audited comparatives; click through the four statement tabs
scenes.vo: The finance module turns your books into audit-style statements — Activities, Financial Position, Cash Flows and Net Assets — generated from a trial balance or a QuickBooks sync, tied out against prior year and audit, and always current.

scenes.shows: NMB /budget — the guided budget summary: money in, spending, net, cost per student
scenes.vo: Budgets live right beside the actuals. Build one the guided way — answer a few questions — or import the spreadsheet you already have. Money in, spending by category, and net income, ready to compare against reality all year.

scenes.shows: Budget workspace → Organizational roll-up tab → Consolidated statements tab
scenes.vo: And for the network: one click rolls every school's budget up to the organization — and the consolidated statements read the whole system as a single set of financials.

scenes.shows: Board Report wizard on Sample High: period → 'Confirm the pulled financials' (from saved statements+budget) → variance table → Draft with AI writes the MD&A → Generate
scenes.vo: And when the board meets, you don't build the packet — you assemble it. Pick the period, and Cairo pulls what already exists: your saved statements, your budget, your key indicators. Confirm the financials — the variance table is already filled in. Then the narrative: one click on Draft with A I, and the management discussion writes itself from the numbers. Review it, tweak a line if you like — and generate. Board-ready, without the weekend.

scenes.shows: Sample High /analytics — Overview story, Charts (mix donuts + trends), Scorecard, then Peers
scenes.vo: Analytics tells the story three ways. An overview in plain English. Charts, for the money mix and the trends across saved years. And a scorecard that grades every metric against healthy bands. Then flip to Peers — and compare your school with schools like yours. Same size band. Same county. Same grade span.

scenes.shows: South Plantation /cash-flow — accept the QuickBooks opening balance, projection builds, horizons, Workbook view
scenes.vo: Now, cash. For QuickBooks-connected schools the forecast types itself — open invoices, bills due, and a year of history become a rolling projection. Five horizons, a chart that flags your low point before it arrives, and an Excel-style workbook when you want the grid.

scenes.shows: South Plantation /cash — Cash & Collections: KPI tiles, aging profile, receivables register, needs-attention
scenes.vo: Cash and Collections is the rear-view mirror. Where the forecast predicts what's coming, this maps what has already happened — receivables and payables, aging, and exactly who is overdue and by how long. It's exclusive to QuickBooks-connected schools, and it lights up on its own.

scenes.shows: NMB /accreditation — projected index gauge, Frameworks modal (multiple adopted), fastest path, click a standard
scenes.vo: Accreditation runs as an engine, not a binder. Adopt one framework — or several, side by side. Every standard carries a rating, evidence and next steps, the fastest path is computed for you, and the projected index climbs as you work — so you always know how far you are from accredited.

scenes.shows: Penny Studio on Sample High: task ask → proposed change → Confirm → Applied; then 'explain our revenue mix and show me the chart' → breakdown + inline donut
scenes.vo: And here's the feature that changes the job: Penny Studio. Penny is an A I chief of staff who can carry out any manual task on the site — file documents, create records, update plans. You just ask. Watch — we ask her to set up a contract review task. She drafts the change, and asks permission first — nothing happens without your confirm. One click... done. Logged, and undoable. And she's just as fluent in the numbers. Ask her to explain your revenue mix — and she breaks it down and draws the chart right in the chat. Eighty seven percent tuition, and what that concentration means. Any question. Any task. Penny does the clicking.

scenes.shows: Fast montage — governance, facilities, advancement, strategy
scenes.vo: Governance. Facilities. Advancement. Strategy. Eight domains — one morning briefing.

scenes.shows: Trust card: FERPA shield, end-to-end encryption lock, AWS logo — built HTML matching the endcard cinema
scenes.vo: And beneath it all — trust. Cairo is FERPA compliant, with student privacy by design. Every record is encrypted end to end — in transit, and at rest. And the entire platform is hosted on Amazon Web Services — enterprise grade infrastructure, secured around the clock.
Cairo. The operating platform for independent schools. See it on your own books — at our Cairo dot com.
